# Vendored dependency

`nlohmann/json` 3.12.0, official single-header distribution:
https://github.com/nlohmann/json/releases/tag/v3.12.0

The unmodified header is `nlohmann/json.hpp`; its MIT license is
`nlohmann/LICENSE.MIT`. DBGLink-specific limits and duplicate-key rejection
live in `NativeJson.cpp`, outside the dependency.
